summary: Aura Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering comprised 39,591,000 firm shares at $6.00 each and pre-funded warrants at $5.99999 each, with underwriters' option for 6,508,650 additional shares exercised in full. Net proceeds of approximately $280.8 million will fund clinical programs and repurchase $39 million of outstanding convertible notes. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven catalyst. The filing is a routine disclosure of a definitive agreement for a public offering, which is ordinary course financing.
